setup.data_isolation: fresh browser context and a newly provisioned fixture workspace per execution

requirements.text: A creator can start a new draft from the dashboard.
A draft has a title and a caption.
Saving a draft keeps its title and caption. After a page reload, the saved values are still shown.
A creator can schedule a post from the dashboard by giving a post title and a publish date.
A publish date in the past must be rejected: the form shows a validation message and no post is scheduled. "Past" means before the studio date shown on the scheduling form.
